description: React component for a photo gallery page with search, filter, and lightbox functionality.

methods.name: GalleryPage
methods.description: Main React functional component rendering the gallery page with search, filter, and lightbox features.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Opens a photo in the lightbox and updates URL route.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the lightbox and resets URL route.

methods.name: onPrev
methods.description: Navigate to previous photo in the filtered list.

methods.name: onNext
methods.description: Navigate to next photo in the filtered list.

methods.name: copyLink
methods.description: Copies share URL of a photo to clipboard and shows live message.
